# unifi_network_dynamic_dns (Resource)

A UniFi dynamic-DNS updater (`dynamicdns`, legacy `/rest`) — publishes the gateway's WAN IP to a DDNS provider so a hostname tracks a changing IP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The fully-qualified hostname to keep updated.
- `service` (String) DDNS provider key (e.g. `dyndns`, `namecheap`, `noip`, `cloudflare`, `custom`). Use `custom` together with `server`.

### Optional

- `interface` (String) WAN interface whose IP is published (e.g. `wan`). Defaults to `wan`.
- `login` (String) Provider account username.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Provider password/token (`x_password`). Write-only: the controller does not echo it back, so the configured value is preserved in state.
- `server` (String) Update server hostname. Required when `service = custom`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
